# Theming decisions

The log of the product owner's design decisions. Each entry is a decision, never a
proposal. What an agent proposes stays in its report until the owner approves it here.
A decision in this log stays decided: later rounds, ported fixes and agents do not undo
it. When something collides with one, ask, with the options.

## Pending decisions

None. H8 and H9 were decided on 2026-11-14 and the two points the headers' review left open (the number that did not fit the details' bar, the two schema keys without a reader) on 2026-11-17: the log above.

Nothing blocks a merge. The two things the sixth round left for the owner, the new-order alert's rhythm and a retention for `tracking_events`, were decided on 2026-11-20 (rows above). What still waits for him is a native speaker's read of the catalog, its corrected and its left "business" and "disabled" texts included, and the project's name for the production APK, and, since the eighth round, the order card's new catalog strings (`CARD_TIME_LEFT`, `CARD_TIME_LATE`, `CARD_TIME_DUE`, `PAID` and `TIME_DAY` in 11 locales) and the calls of the rows "Calls made in the eighth round" and "Calls made in the ninth round", which he has not seen; the band's new strings are none (the catalog did not change in the ninth round). **Since rounds 10 to 12:** the catalog also gained `ASSIGNED`, `HISTORY`, six empty texts, the minutes' seven, the route's 28 and the connection sheet's 14 (no native speaker has read them), and the owner has not seen the calls of the row "Calls made in rounds 10 to 12"; the route's and the connection sheet's first look on a device are the pass 12's (done on 2026-11-23). **Options that wait for the owner, none decided:** the 4 pt overlap of the route map's stacked 44 pt touch zones (leave, a gap of 12 or 15 on the three maps, or 44 pt buttons: the row "Calls made in round 13"); whether the accept sheet's position stepper is prefilled with the order's own position (it shows "#" now: pass 12); a per-base flag `builder_bases.themed` in api-core (the row "The Builder's driver and store bases"); and what a group of orders offered at status 4 should show (no "Accept all" today).

## Phase 7: visible changes to review

Implementation choices that change the look, inside what was approved, waiting for the
owner's review on device. They become decisions above once approved.

| Batch | Where | Change | Why |
|---|---|---|---|

| Primitives | `OText` | Legacy sizes snap to the preset scale (13 → 12, 15 → 14, 17 → 16, 22 / 26 → 24…); texts get the preset's line height; a family named in a style is ignored; the default text color is the theme's `text` (it was the literal #344050) | tokens.md §5 |

## Phase 9: one look, round 1 (2026-11-13)

Seen on devices: the screens before the login, on the iPhone 17 simulator and on an
Android emulator ([verification.md](verification.md)). Fixed without a decision, because
they are faults and not choices:

| Area | Change | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Assign request | The detail has its back button again: the screen's bar, as the order's details | The conversion had left the screen without a way back |
| Fields | A field, a select and a text area keep the room of their states' border at rest (1 pt, see-through): the text no longer moves when a field turns to error | Harmony: a state never moves its control. Seen and measured on Android |
| Accessibility | "Close", "Go back" and "Enter verification code" are translated for the screen reader; the delivery PIN names its order | They were English in every language |
| Refresh | The orders list and the schedule read the spinner's color (the same by default) | One place per role |
| Images | A logo or a photo is asked at twice its box, as WebP | The SDK's `optimizeImage` returns its URL unchanged; not seen on a device |
| Sessions | The list keeps its order when it re-renders | It reversed the controller's array in place (inherited) |

The rest of the audit is H1–H10 above and [harmony.md](harmony.md); the performance
review is [PERFORMANCE.md](../PERFORMANCE.md).

## Phase 9: one look, round 2 (2026-11-13) — decisions H1–H7

Done in code by three area agents over shared pieces (one list of status names, one
order-number label, one order type label, the formats, `FieldError`, `PasswordToggle`,
`OSpinner`, a dialog's close, a sheet's padding); each diff read and merged by the
coordinator, 1 191 tests. **Seen on a device: only the login** (the password eye; the
field measured 44 pt, as the e-mail's). Everything else below is behind the login and is
computed from the theme's defaults, not seen.

| Area | What a driver sees now (before) | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| Status names | Status 4 reads "Ready for pickup" in the details, the driver map, the copied text and the messages ("Preparation Completed"); status 5 "Rejected by business" in the messages ("Rejected") | H1 |
| Order number | "Order No. 101", one label and one space, masked in a secure project, on the orders card ("Order No.101"; in Spanish it read "No101"), the messages row, the chat's header, the driver map, a group's order in the details ("Order #101"), the payouts card and a map marker's callout (**both showed the raw id** in a secure project) | H2 |
| Order type | The details name catering delivery, catering pickup and reservation ("Driver thru"); an unknown type reads "Delivery" | H3 |
| Dates and times | The search's picked range and the summary's dates in the project's date format (the API's `MM/DD/YYYY`); the schedule's title is the weekday and the project's date ("Friday, November 13, 2026"), its hours and the blocked screen's in the project's time format, without seconds (always 24 h); the code countdown "09:59" in the OTP login ("9:59"); the driver map's travel time "12 min" / "1 h 33 min" ("12.36 - Minutes"), and a stopped driver keeps its last estimate (the unit flipped to hours) | H4 |
| Cancel | Neutral outline in the chat's and the driver map's sheets (secondary solid) and in the OTP login (primary outline) | H5 |
| Dialogs and sheets | The requirements dialog's Close is neutral from both screens (secondary from the details); the driver map leaves by the header's back arrow (a close X at the end); the new-order and the connection dialogs use the dialog's own close in the corner (their own rows; Android's back now closes the new-order one and stops its sound); the chat's message options are list rows with a glyph (stacked solid buttons); the calendar and notifications sheets have the sheet's 20 pt under their content (15; 0) | H5 |
| Small controls | The unread count on the details' chat button is the primary badge of 24 (red, 20); "Delivery #N" in accept / reject is a primary badge (colored text); the payouts' notice action is the small outline button (solid, 44, full width); the login's password eye is the profile's, and a password field is as tall as the others | H5 |
| Logos and names | A store's logo is a rounded square in the chat's header, recipients and "Sent to" (a circle); the store's name on the driver map is 14 / 600 (14 / 400) | H5 |
| Empty and error states | Sessions with none or turned off, and the Stripe account's load error, are the app's empty state: the picture, the message at 16 muted, the action full width (plain texts; a card with a danger glyph). "Go back" of the schedule-blocked screen is full width | H5 |
| Accept / reject bar | The bottom bar's shadow, and as a page its background reaches the bottom of the screen. The rest of H6 (the screen's own copy of the bar) is done in round 3 below | H6 |
| Text roles | Leads at 16 (`body_lg`) in forgot password, review and accept / reject (14); "Upload status image" and "Security code" are section titles at the start (centered labels); **(that part superseded on 2026-11-19 by "Labels inside a sheet or a reason form": 14 / 600 labels with a muted 12 description)**; a field's error starts where its field does (centered in the phone field, the welcome screen's project and the status image) and is centered only under a code entry; "Your previous cellphone" is muted information (the error red); "Ingredients:" and option names are 14 / 600 muted as "Comment" (14 / 400) | H7 |

Not done, and why: the accept / reject screen's own bar (H6: it needs a blocked state and
a single action in the accept slot in `FloatingButton`); the chat's recipients stay
hand-made check rows (`ChoiceRow` is a boxed option); the order number inside the
new-order dialog's translated sentences ("Order #N has …": three new sentence keys); the
orders card of a project with external ids writes the external id alone where the details
write "Order No. EXT-55"; the group number has two keys and no space; the minutes behind
the order timer are still computed in two files.

## Phase 9: one look, round 3: defects seen on devices (2026-11-13)

The device pass on both platforms with the served theme ([verification.md](verification.md)
§7). These are faults, not choices; nothing in H8 or H9 changed. Each has a test.

| Area | What a driver sees now (before) | Cause |
|---|---|---|
| Orders search, date calendar | The calendar takes the width of its sheet (about 160 pt of 402, the weekday names "Mon" and "Wed" on two lines) | `OCalendar`'s container shrank to its content; it now stretches, and a weekday name is one line |
| Full-screen modals on Android | The orders search's header sits below the status bar (it was drawn beside the clock on API 37); iOS is unchanged | `OModal` read the safe-area insets outside its own `SafeAreaProvider`: 0 on Android, where the activity pads the screens and the modal's window does not |
| Order not found, and every list that showed an API error | "Order not found" (the raw code `ERROR_ORDER_FIND`); an API error is worded by `getTraduction`, none falls back to "Network Error" | The error list of the controller was shown as it came (`apiErrorText`; the key is in the catalog and the 11 locales) |
| Accept / reject, bottom bar | The same bar (same frames before and after, on both platforms), now the app's `FloatingButton`: one action in the accept / danger / primary slot, blocked (faded, answers a tap), disabled, inline above the keyboard. The screen no longer carries its own copy of the bar's styles. A long label shrinks to one line as in the other bars (it wrapped) | H6 |
| Messages list | The number and date line takes two lines and the timer and status badges wrap, instead of "02:05..." and "Accepted by d..." (at the system's default size on a 402 pt phone, and more with a larger one) | One line with an ellipsis |
| Profile | The row reads "Logout" (it read "logout", like a raw key), in every language | The catalog's English and locales were lower case |
